text: キミは　つりの　ロマンの　なんたるかを　わかってるな！

structure.jp: つりの　ロマンの　なんたるかを
structure.en: what the romance of fishing really is

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: ロマンの　なんたるかを
patterns.explanation: A question ending in か can sit inside a bigger sentence as the thing that is known. 〜の　なんたるか is a stiff set way to say 'what something truly is'. ロマンの　なんたるか = 'what the romance really is'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says a state is going on right now. わかってる is the short spoken form of わかっている. わかってる = 'you understand'.
